answer: Each agent must lock a refundable deposit in an on-chain vault before it can act, and sign its attestations with a Falcon key bound to that deposit. In the attestation graph every identity is a vertex whose influence is capped by its stake, so spinning up a thousand fake agents means funding a thousand vaults. Honest peers slash the deposit of any vertex caught attesting falsely, making a Falcon-signed sybil fleet cost real, forfeitable capital per node instead of being a free fork.
